name: Koukawa Saki
source: A girl hospitalized at Nishikata Hospital and one of Haruto's childhood friends. She has a heart condition. She used to be shy and reclusive when she was first admitted to Nishikiata Hospital. But after getting to know Aoi, she started to aim to become a cheerful person. She never wants to leave Honoka's side.
translation: A girl hospitalized at Nishikata Hospital and one of Haruto's childhood friends. She has a heart condition.
